description: Utility charges with effective dates. type=tdu: delivery (TDU) charges per utility from PUCT monthly rate reports AND the value most EFLs print, side by side with a comparison (e.g. Oncor's per-kWh charge differs between the two sources; both are shown). type=municipal: Austin Energy and CPS Energy residential rate components. Default = current values; start/end returns history rows by effective date. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

utility.description: oncor, centerpoint, aep_central, aep_north, tnmp, lpl, nueces, austin_energy, cps_energy
